summary: A media query applies CSS only when a condition is true, such as the screen being at least 500px wide. Start with phone styles, then add min-width queries for bigger screens.
notes: The preview is about 640px wide, so (min-width: 500px) is true and (min-width: 900px) is false: you see two columns.
Narrower than 500px (a phone), neither query applies: one column. 900px or wider, both apply and the later one wins: four columns.
To test it, open the page in your browser and drag the window narrower and wider.
pitfall: Putting the @media block above the normal rules. The normal rule comes later, so it wins and the media query seems to do nothing.
